purpose: Machine-readable setup specifications. Prose is not executable; these are.

global_rules.min_rr_note: This floor has no per-setup exceptions. A mean-reversion setup needs a 1.5R target to be mean reversion at all, so it cannot clear this bar and is deliberately excluded. Weakening the floor for one setup weakens it for all of them.
no_trade_if: circuit limit hit in last 3 sessions

setups.name: Trend Pullback Continuation
setups.entry: Close above prior day high after a 3-8 session pullback that holds above the 20DMA and does not close below the 50DMA.
setups.stop: Below the pullback low, or 1.5 x ATR(14) below entry, whichever is closer.
setups.target: Prior swing high; if already exceeded, 2.5 x initial risk.
setups.invalidation: Daily close below the 50DMA, or the pullback low is broken before entry.
confirmation: RSI(14) between 40 and 65 at the pullback low
setups.notes: This is the highest-expectancy setup for daily data. It fails in choppy ranges, which is why regime_required is enforced.

setups.name: Range Breakout with Volume
setups.entry: Daily close above the top of a range that has held for at least 15 sessions.
setups.stop: Below the range midpoint, or 2 x ATR(14) below entry.
setups.target: Range height projected from the breakout point.
setups.invalidation: Close back inside the range within 3 sessions (failed breakout).
confirmation: volume >= 1.5 x 20D average on the breakout day
range width between 4% and 15% of price
no more than 3 touches of the range top before the break
setups.notes: Most breakouts fail. The 3-session re-entry rule is the filter; without it this setup has negative expectancy.

setups.name: Volatility Contraction Base Breakout
setups.entry: Close above the pivot of a base where ATR has contracted for at least 3 consecutive weeks.
setups.stop: Below the base low, or 7% below entry, whichever is closer.
setups.invalidation: Base low broken, or ATR expands without a price breakout.
confirmation: ATR(14) at a 3-month low before the breakout
volume dry-up in the final third of the base
setups.notes: Needs a longer horizon than trend_pullback. Do not apply this on a 5-day horizon.

setups.name: Relative Strength Leader Pullback
setups.entry: Stock in the top decile of 3-month relative strength vs Nifty, pulling back to the 20DMA and closing above it.
setups.stop: Below the 50DMA, or 2 x ATR(14) below entry.
setups.invalidation: Relative strength rank drops below the 50th percentile, or the 50DMA breaks.
confirmation: market regime is trend_up, not range
setups.notes: Requires a benchmark series (Nifty) aligned on the same calendar. Without it, do not emit this setup.
